title: LakeSpeak Question Pack (v1alpha1)
description: A version-controlled set of Genie questions that produce a repeatable report. Question Packs are data, never code: nothing here can execute a command, read a file, or widen the permissions of the identity running it.

apiVersion.description: Pinned so a pack written today keeps its meaning when the schema evolves. Write lakespeak.net/v1alpha1; the lakespeak.dev spelling predates the project's domain and still loads.

name.description: Lowercase kebab-case. Used in output filenames, so it must be filesystem-safe.

agent.description: Agent id, exact title, or an alias configured locally. Required and never inferred: a report that silently ran against a different Agent is worse than one that failed.

profile.description: Databricks CLI profile. A profile name only; never a credential.

questions.description: Capped because each question is a Genie conversation costing warehouse time. A pack that fans out to hundreds of questions is a scheduled job, not a report.

id.description: Stable identifier. Used as the anchor in generated reports, so renaming it breaks existing links.

timeout.description: Positive per-question wait, for example 90s or 5m. Falls back to the pack default.

format.description: Only markdown is implemented. JSON reports are reserved for a later schema version; the loader rejects anything else.

path.description: Written relative to the pack file. Absolute paths and parent-directory traversal are rejected at load time.

continueOnQuestionFailure.description: When true the run completes and failed questions are reported in place, exiting 8 for partial failure. When false the first failure stops the run.

includeIdentifiers.description: Record conversation and message ids in the report so an answer can be traced back in Databricks. Off by default because those ids identify a conversation containing governed data.

timeout.description: Positive default wait for questions without their own timeout.
